scope: Read-only repo audit of Unity art, source files, Tripo and UPM packages; no owner-account receipts, downloaded APK build analysis or legal certification.
method: Repository tracked paths and internal audit manifests, official vendor EULA and source terms. Presence/identity is not proof of licensing or rights to redistribute. Risk is operational, not a legal finding.

definitions.CRITICAL: Evidence of a specific redistribution restriction plus public raw files or nested third-party rights; immediate human/owner action recommended
definitions.HIGH: Raw public sources or game assets lacking license acquisition/derivation evidence
definitions.MEDIUM: Notices or traceability requirements; no permission claim without per-artifact proof

families.rights_evidence: Folder and publisher INFO exist; store listing standard EULA, but exact acquired SKU/version and account receipt not established. Seller README points to separate paid pack; do not confuse.
proof_required: Unity account My Assets acquisition/download record with matching SKU and licensed entity
Exact package version/original licence and no nonstandard restrictions
Public raw-source repository distribution permission or removal from public exposure
Unity BuildReport dependency mapping

families.rights_evidence: Store listing Standard EULA; bundled README contains help/support instructions but no acquisition-specific licence receipt.
proof_required: My Assets account receipt/SKU and version for this content
Public raw-source permission separately from embedded game use
Unity BuildReport dependency mapping

families.rights_evidence: Bundled info.txt states content can be used in commercial products; does not grant unrestricted source-file redistribution. Original purchase/download licence not attached to reviewed asset files.
proof_required: My Assets receipt/version (Nature Starter Kit 2 v1.0 where matched)
Check restricted or publisher-specific terms, including embedded scripts
Separate permission for public source files if retained

families.rights_evidence: Publisher and listing correspond to tracked folder; Standard EULA listing, but owner's specific entitlement not verified.
proof_required: Exact account acquisition and package version
Embedded use vs GitHub raw source clearance
Determine whether current build references these prefabs

families.rights_evidence: Tracked external supplier folder confirmed, but exact official SKU/version and end-user licensing record not established from reviewed files.
proof_required: Exact Unity store listing SKU, publisher and legal terms
Entitlement, original download/version
Build dependency check and public raw-source treatment

families.rights_evidence: Official listing: Mountain - Stylized Fantasy Environment, Standard Asset Store EULA and Free at time of check; acquisition/version still unverified.
proof_required: My Assets SKU/version and licensed party
Public source redistribution permission or remove from public exposure
Actual Unity usage and dependency classification

families.category: Unity Asset Store art with third-party textures
families.rights_evidence: Tracked Doc/1_Readme.txt mentions URP Tree Pack 11 (exact SKU requires cross-check). Doc/2_Notices.txt says some textures use Textures.com and are not redistributable by default. Terms distinguish embedded game from independent source distribution.
proof_required: Identify exact URP Tree Pack SKU/version/acquisition
Match Textures.com textures, third-party notices and any publisher sublicensing
Remove unlicensed public raw exposure by owner-approved coordinated workflow or obtain explicit rights
BuildReport game inclusion and required notices

families.rights_evidence: Three FBX models tracked. Current FAQ states CC0; newer QAL v1.0 dated 2026-08-28 permits commercial product use but prohibits distributing assets themselves. No pinned per-file acquisition/licence evidence supplied.
proof_required: Original download URL, exact pack and date
Saved licence at the time of download (CC0 grant versus QAL)
Do not assume raw GitHub publication is permitted under new QAL; reconcile FAQ conflict

families.rights_evidence: 26 classified shelf items; all explicitly set license_certified:false (4 production + 20 conditional + 1 landmark + 1 blocked archive); these ratings cover visual/technical functions only.
proof_required: Identify creator and chain of title per final GLB + textures
Record original image/texture/reference licence and model derivation
Link provenance to active Unity prefab/Resources mapping
Separately clear public source and player embedding

families.rights_evidence: Read-only catalog records task ID, 20 historical credits, raw/optimized/editable hashes; no paid/free account status and no license snapshot tied to generation was verified.
proof_required: Generation plan and API tier at task date; original invoice or credit record
Rights in source input image/prompt, AI provider's applicable terms/version
Per-model chain-of-title, published game vs standalone model use

families.rights_evidence: Read-only catalog proves task/outputs and 20 credits but not fee entitlement/licensing tier at creation; technical QA != rights.
proof_required: Generation tier at task date; proof of paid-account rights if needed
Copyright clearance of generation inputs and edits
Record whether game includes this model

families.rights_evidence: Read-only catalog confirms task and 20 credits; art-only candidate, not approved gameplay object. No account-specific license proof.
proof_required: Generation plan and receipt of 20-credit task
Rights of referenced concept image and use in derived models
Retain sandbox/no gameplay promotion until separately cleared

families.rights_evidence: Git dependency pinned in packages-lock to revision 6c0258189a2b124af1282fa9236fd9b6637f1a1a; upstream documents MIT and several MIT/other third-party notices. No full installed package notice-set reviewed in this audit.
proof_required: Bundle MIT copyright and required transitive notices appropriate to shipped Player
Review third-party native libraries included by pinned revision
Check whether code actually included in APK/WebGL

families.rights_evidence: UPM v6.14.1; upstream repository Apache-2.0. Exact package notices and runtime build inclusion remain to verify.
proof_required: Retain Apache-2.0 license/copyright/NOTICE where applicable
Verify package 6.14.1 content and ship-target binaries

families.rights_evidence: Lock v0.3.22; upstream unity.webp MIT; bundled libwebp BSD and possible prior Apache components. Exact installed third-party notices not inspected.
proof_required: Inventory libwebp, WebGL plugin and transitive components for Android/WebGL
Carry each required MIT/BSD/other notice in release legal material
